title: Heavenly Dao Sword
next_chapter_hook: "When Chen Ji's roar echoed through the void, the Fate Writer simply replied indifferently: 'This is merely the first path. There is a second, a third... Are you certain you wish to see it through?'"

text.content: "In the void space, Chen Ji's fingertips still retained the warmth of his trembling moments. The scene was too vivid—he could almost smell the faint bamboo fragrance on Su Qingyao, hear her silent cry in her final breath. 'This is the path of Heavenly Dao Sword.' The Fate Writer's voice was cold as frost, 'Do you wish to see it clearly? Do you wish to see the future you have chosen with your own hands?' Chen Ji did not answer, only slowly clenched his fists. The pain of nails piercing his palms was nothing compared to the tearing agony in his chest."

dialogue.content: "The first path: Heavenly Dao Sword." The Fate Writer's voice echoed through the void, "You shall become the Heavenly Realm's Law Enforcer, wielding the sword of heaven's will, severing all existence that disturbs heavenly secrets. The world shall return to order, all things shall follow their course. You shall obtain supreme power above the three great sects, lifespan equal to heaven, and dao fused with heaven."

text.content: "The moment the voice fell, the void before Chen Ji twisted violently. A massive scene unfurled like a scroll—a vast celestial palace, with white jade as steps and golden tiles as eaves, countless auspicious qi and propitious clouds swirling around. At the highest point of the celestial palace, a majestic figure sat upon the divine throne. Clad in plain white heavenly dao robes, surrounded by countless flowing runes, with a translucent immortal sword suspended above its head. It was him—Chen Ji."

dialogue.content: "This is your future." The Fate Writer's voice carried an inexplicable emotion, "Guardian of heavenly order, protector of all beings across the realms. You shall personally forge an unprecedented era of peace." Chen Ji stared at his reflection in the scene, that face calm to the point of cold indifference, as if all worldly bonds had long been severed. He suddenly realized something, his Adam's apple moving slightly: "What is the price?"

text.content: "The Fate Writer did not answer immediately. Silence itself was an answer. In the void, the scene suddenly shifted, descending from the heights of the celestial palace, passing through layers of clouds, skimming across the countless mountains and rivers lined with sects, finally fixing upon a peak Chen Ji knew intimately—the Tianqing Sect. Among the verdant pines, a slender figure practiced swordsmanship. The cyan bamboo skirt swayed gently in the wind, sword light like a ribbon sweeping across the sky, each move carrying an inviolable edge."

dialogue.content: "Su Qingyao, Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect, exceptional talent, fierce temperament." The Fate Writer's voice carried no emotion, "This person has repeatedly窥探天机运转, becoming the greatest variable disturbing heavenly order." Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, a fierce light flashing in his eyes: "What are you saying?" In the scene, Su Qingyao seemed to sense something, sheathed her sword and stood, looking up at the void. Those cold, clear eyes passed through countless layers of space, as if gazing directly at Chen Ji."

text.content: "At this moment, a massive eye suddenly opened in the void above Su Qingyao's head. The pupil was dark as an abyss, the iris flowing with countless mysterious runes, emanating an overwhelming pressure that stole one's breath. It was the eye of heaven—the materialized manifestation of heavenly will. Su Qingyao's sword flew from her grasp, her entire body pinned in place by that pressure, unable to move. 'Variable,' the eye of heaven spoke with a thunderous voice, 'Judged as the root of disturbance to heavenly secrets. Ordered for erasure.'"

dialogue.content: "'No!' Chen Ji let out a heart-wrenching shriek. He wanted to rush into the scene but found himself immobilized. In the image, Su Qingyao struggled to raise her head, lips slightly parting, as if speaking something. Chen Ji understood that lip-read—she said, 'Chen Ji, survive.' In the next instant, a brilliant white light shot from the center of the heavenly eye, instantly engulfing Su Qingyao's form."

text.content: "Where the white light dissipated, Su Qingyao's figure became translucent like dust scattered by wind, bit by bit. She did not scream, did not beg for mercy, only quietly gazing at the void—at the direction where Chen Ji was. A peaceful smile even appeared at the corner of her lips. That smile pierced Chen Ji's heart like a blade, as if something in his chest cavity was shattering. His Heavenly Fate Value burned frantically—that was his connection to the Tianji Record, the foundation of his foresight ability, the only thing he could do at this moment—watching helplessly."

dialogue.content: "'Heavenly Dao Enforcer, no personal attachments allowed.' The Fate Writer's voice was like a cold judgment, 'Su Qingyao's existence would interfere with the Tianji Record's operation, would shake your judgment. Her existence is the greatest flaw on this path.' Chen Ji fell to his knees, hands supporting the ground of nothingness, shoulders trembling violently. He heard himself make a beast-like whimper: 'Is this the price you spoke of...?'"

text.content: "The image still did not fade. The remnants of fate's threads went madly distorting where Su Qingyao had vanished—that was heaven erasing all traces of her existence. The Tianqing Sect's mountain gate still stood, but no one would remember ever an Inner Disciple Senior Fellow practicing sword here. The entire world's memory of Su Qingyao was erased—except Chen Ji. He would forever remember her smile, her sword, her final 'live.' This was the true price of the Heavenly Dao Sword path: making your beloved vanish completely from the world, yet eternally carving the pain in your heart."

choice.prompt: "Chen Ji knelt in the void, nails deeply embedded in his palms, blood dripping. The Fate Writer waited quietly, as if examining a work of art. 'This is the first path,' its voice had no temperature, 'Heavenly Dao Sword, world peace, the price is her. Do you... accept?'"

choices.visible_cost: "Losing Su Qingyao, forever carrying this heartache"

text.content: "Chen Ji slowly rose to his feet, eyes blood-red, voice hoarse to the point of being out of tune: 'I... accept.' Three words seemed to have drained all his strength. The Fate Writer let out an inexplicable sigh: 'Very well. Then Su Qingyao shall be completely erased from this fate line. And you shall inherit the mantle of Heavenly Dao Sword Bearer.'"

choices.description: "This path is not worth it—he would rather make an enemy of heaven than lose her"
choices.visible_cost: "Losing the authority bestowed by heaven, facing unknown fate alone"
choices.risk_hint: "Heaven will not easily let you go"

text.content: "Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, eyes burning with mad flames: 'I refuse!' His voice exploded in the void, 'If heaven's order requires her life to sustain it, then let this order perish!' The Fate Writer's pupils slightly contracted: 'Do you know what you are saying? You are opposing heaven.'"

choices.description: "Is this truly the only path? Why must heaven be so cruel?"

text.content: "Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the surging emotions, voice low yet carrying an undeniable edge: 'Is this truly the only path? Must the Heavenly Dao Sword Bearer sever all personal attachments? Is Su Qingyao's life truly essential to maintaining order, or is it... your private agenda?' The Fate Writer's form stiffened slightly, the void's temperature dropping sharply."

"Chen Ji knelt in the void, shoulders trembling violently. The scene from moments ago remained vivid in his mind—Su Qingyao's final peaceful smile, like an invisible blade, gouging his heart over and over. 'Is this the so-called first path?' His voice was hoarse to the point of being unrecognizable, 'Let an innocent person bear the karmic consequences simply because I chose this path?'"

"He slowly stood up, knuckles white from gripping. Heavenly Fate Value surged wildly within him—that was the power granted by the Tianji Record, also the only thing he could rely on at this moment. The Fate Writer watched him silently, that massive eye showing not a trace of emotional fluctuation, as if merely examining a chess piece already destined. 'Chen Ji,' its voice was like ancient, biting cold, 'Your anger is meaningless. Heaven's operation follows its own laws; any variable must be erased.'"

dialogue.content: "'Variable?' Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, pupils burning with mad flames, 'She never actively interfered with heavenly secrets! She only... she only discovered me!' His voice trembled yet carried undeniable resolve, 'Su Qingyao never intended to oppose heaven; she only wanted to protect the people she cared about. If this is a crime, then this heaven, forget it!'"

text.content: "The moment the words fell, the void quivered. The Fate Writer's form suddenly pressed close, that heavenly eye almost filling Chen Ji's entire field of vision: 'Bold.' Two words like thunderclaps exploded in Chen Ji's mind, 'Do you think possessing the Tianji Record Fragment gives you the right to question heaven? Have any of the previous prophets ever met good ends?' Its voice was ice-cold and piercing, 'Either accept, or be destroyed. There is no third path.'"

choice.prompt: "The Fate Writer's pressure bore down like a mountain, Chen Ji felt as if he would be crushed into powder. Yet his spine never bent, the mad light in his eyes only burning more intensely. 'No third path?' He laughed lowly, laughter bleak and resolute, 'Then I shall forge one.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji abruptly bit through his tongue, a mouthful of heart's blood sprayed into the void. Heavenly Fate Value rushed out like a breached dam, transforming into brilliant golden light that enveloped his entire body. The Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea went madly trembling, countless mysterious runes surged forth like a tide. Deep within that light, he glimpsed a faint line—another path."

Heaven's operation follows its own laws... any variable must be erased... then, what if Su Qingyao was no longer a variable? What if he could find a method to integrate her into the order?"

text.content: "Chen Ji took a deep breath, slowly knelt on one knee: 'I accept.' When these three words left his mouth, his heart felt as if a piece had been cut out. A satisfied light flashed in the Fate Writer's eye: 'A wise man knows when to bow. From this day forth, you are the candidate for Heavenly Dao Sword Bearer.' Chen Ji lowered his head, a cold smile secretly forming at the corner of his mouth."

"In the void, Chen Ji's scream still echoed. 'Is this the future you have chosen?' His voice was hoarse and desolate, pointing at the gradually fading scene, 'Let her bear karmic consequences she should never have to bear—is this heaven's justice?' The Fate Writer fell silent for a moment, that heavenly eye slightly narrowing, as if examining an interesting toy."

"'Justice?' A hint of mockery actually entered the Fate Writer's voice, 'Heaven never speaks of justice. Heaven only speaks of order.' Its form slowly manifested in the void, a blurred outline with no face, no gender, only a massive eye suspended in endless light. 'Su Qingyao's existence does interfere with the Tianji Record's operation. And you, as the holder of the Tianji Record, are destined to make a choice between her and heaven.'"

dialogue.content: "'Destined?' Chen Ji gave a tragic laugh, 'I never believed in any destiny.' He struggled to stand, swaying yet his gaze blazing like a torch, 'The Tianji Record grants me the ability to foresee the future, not to submit to fate, but to have the power to change it. Su Qingyao should not die, should not pay the price for your so-called order.' He paused, voice turning cold, 'I will find the third path.'"

text.content: "The Fate Writer let out a low laugh, like an ancient god sighing: 'The third path? Interesting. Then let me see how far you can go.' Before the words finished, the void twisted violently. Chen Ji felt his body being forcefully pulled by an invisible force, his vision going black. When he opened his eyes again, he found himself back in the bamboo grove of Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. Su Qingyao stood quietly not far away, her sword hanging down, beautiful eyes filled with worry. 'Chen Ji, what happened to you... your face looks so terrible...'"
